device.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

decision.interpretation: Making geometry causal materially improves replay alignment, but the compact state closure remains near the zero-predictor error scale on held-out recurrent states. Capacity tuning is not justified without a stronger Markov representation or a jointly trained adaptive rule.
decision.deployment: CPU-reference diagnostic only; resident WGPU closure deployment is rejected because it does not implement causal phase/state perception and integration.
decision.next_training_path: Joint normalized-adaptive NPA training across mixed material resolutions with Target2D and restriction-evolution losses; keep persistent fine modes only as a diagnostic ceiling and the verified LoD baseline.

paper_claim_boundary: The supplied budgeted-adaptive paper reports an adaptive-bandwidth pilot and presents learned topology/proxy hierarchy as proposed work. This closure experiment is a repository diagnostic, not a reproduced paper result.
